sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier has type-2 mandibles and the smallest head capsule among the species of this type. The most similar species is O. longilamina, from which it differs in the narrower mandibles and the weakly constricted apex of the head.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Sides of the head slightly convergent anteriorly in dorsal view. Dorsal tubercle slightly prominent in lateral view, situated behind the lateral projection. Mandibles type 2, with a tooth-like process on the proximal half. Head capsule sparsely setose and with short hairs, denser ventrally, minute hairs scattered over the whole head capsule. Postmentum with setae. Margins of the pronotum with short hairs and setae; posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum with short hairs; abdominal tergites with short hairs and setae, the sternites with short hairs and setae on the posterior margin.
